personal_info.name: Marcell Jeremy Wiradinata
personal_info.title: Data Scientist & Software Engineer
personal_info.headline: Data science, shipped as software.
personal_info.bio: I'm Marcell — a data scientist and software engineer. I take problems from raw tables to trained models to the interfaces people actually use: warehouse pipelines on Snowflake and Databricks, deep learning research, and production-grade front-ends.

pillars.title: Models and analytics that hold up outside the notebook.
capabilities: Deep learning for computer vision & medical imaging

pillars.title: Products that put the data in people's hands.
capabilities: Front-end development for enterprise data platforms
Native iOS & AR experiences in Swift and SwiftUI
LLM agent workflows and custom MCP servers
User-centered design, from research to prototype

currently_building.title: Financial Analytics Platform
currently_building.description: Enterprise-scale analytics and reporting on Snowflake for a Japanese-based enterprise — from warehouse modeling to the dashboards finance teams use every day.

currently_building.title: AI Agent Workflows & MCP Servers
currently_building.description: Building custom Model Context Protocol servers and autonomous agent workflows to understand where LLM tooling is genuinely useful.

education.description: Specialized in deep learning for computer vision and medical image analysis. Thesis research on knee osteoarthritis classification was published in a peer-reviewed journal.

experience.description: Data scientist on Snowflake and Databricks implementations for enterprise clients. Building a financial analytics platform for a Japanese enterprise, leading front-end development, and supporting technical pre-sales in competitive bids.

Commercial due diligence for Japanese acquirers across IT and other sectors. Built Excel market and financial models that informed acquisition strategy, and contributed to a Microsoft-based internal automation project.
Shipped FEAR, an AR exposure-therapy iOS app, and Tetandingan, a 3D offering guide. Worked in cross-functional teams through a user-centered process, from research to working SwiftUI builds.
